column1: # rspinyin decode smoke baseline, regenerated by `xtask testd-smoke --derive-from-holdout`.
# The `core` band is derived; the bands below the marker are handwritten. One case
# per line, TAB separated: case_id  key_sequence  expected_text  [tags...]
# `key_sequence` is raw pinyin; `'` forces a syllable boundary.
# The file is a regression pin: it holds what the engine answers today, and a
# ranking change that turns a line red has to either fix the ranking or make a
# case for the new behaviour by hand.
